grades: Currently in 8th grade (9th grade program) or 9th or 10th grade (Middle College)
notes: Admissions office phone: (734) 677-5360. General line: 734-973-3300. This is a school program, not a job.
name: Washtenaw Technical Middle College (WTMC)
what_you_do: Take high school and college classes at the same time at Washtenaw Community College. You finish with a diploma. You also get a two year degree or a job certificate.
who_can_apply: Michigan residents. 8th graders (9th Grade Program) need passing grades in English, math, science and social studies. 9th graders (Middle College) need 1 credit each in English, math, science, social studies and electives by the end of the school year. 10th graders (Middle College) need 2 credits each in those subjects. Washtenaw County residents get priority.
pay_detail: The page says graduates finish without paying tuition, fees or books.
deadline_text: Registration for the informational meetings begins October 2026. Admissions begins Dec 1, 2026. Online application closes Feb 26, 2027. Letters go out Mar 19, 2027. Lottery Mar 26 if needed. Confirm by Apr 9, 2027.
how_to_apply: Go to an Admissions Informational Meeting first (6:00 to 7:30 PM on Dec 1, 2026; Jan 19, Feb 1, Feb 10 online, Feb 18 online, 2027). Then use the online application. Placement tests follow if you are admitted.
